name: Millennium
overview: The Millennium, as depicted in Isaiah 65:17-22, reveals a future era characterized by God's creation of new heavens and a new earth where former troubles are forgotten. This time will be marked by lasting joy and peace in Jerusalem, with no more weeping or premature death. The people will enjoy the fruits of their labor with security and longevity, reflecting God's blessing and the fulfillment of His promises to His elect.
